text: Italian Gesture is the company of Giovanni Pasquini of Quercianella (Livorno): Il Tirreno's 2025 profile says the company as we know it today was founded in 2009 in Quercianella and describes Italian Gesture as his company ('la sua “Italian Gesture”').
short: Italian Gesture is founded and owned by Giovanni Pasquini of Livorno.

source.name: Il Tirreno: 'Pasquini e quel brand toscano che veste i big della Formula 1'
source.quote: L'azienda “Italian Gesture” – così come la conosciamo oggi – è stata fondata nel 2009 a Quercianella (Livorno)
source.note: Translation: 'The “Italian Gesture” company – as we know it today – was founded in 2009 in Quercianella (Livorno)'. The same article attributes the brand's trophies programme to 'Giovanni Pasquini, con la sua “Italian Gesture”' ('Giovanni Pasquini, with his “Italian Gesture”').
